narrative.headline: Growth accelerated, operations released cash, and the next priority is converting momentum into liquidity.
insights: December sales reached a 2025 monthly high and were 35% above the annual monthly average.
Inventory reduction shortened the cash conversion cycle by 24.1 days and reduced net working capital by approximately $238K.
Receivables remained entirely within current and 1–30 day buckets, but a 43-day DSO leaves a meaningful cash-release opportunity.
The modeled 13-week cash balance remains positive but falls below the current operating-expense safety buffer.
recommendations: Set a 40-day DSO target and review the largest open balances weekly.
Continue reducing slow-moving inventory and validate reorder settings.
Refresh the cash forecast weekly and align vendor payments with expected collections.
